benchmark_summary.promotion_decision: cleanup_implementation defaults to v2: +9 assertions over V1 on the frozen corpus with no critical semantic loss, long-input stage p50 70% lower (2.39 s vs 4.19 s; S24's 201-500-word p50 budget is 8 s), and V1 remains selectable ("v1") and fallback-intact.
benchmark_summary.v2_fallbacks_note: V2's higher fallback count is the validator working as designed: candidates failing deterministic checks ship the immutable normalized source (recoverable, labeled) instead of V1's plausible-but-lossy output — the 14-case assertion gap is V1 content loss.
